tagline.en_US: Runs the AceStream engine and serves its streams over HTTP as HLS or MPEG-TS, for players such as VLC.

description.en_US: AceStream HTTP Proxy runs the AceStream engine and exposes an HTTP streaming interface. It converts AceStream peer-to-peer broadcasts into standard HLS or MPEG-TS streams. This allows media players such as VLC or mpv to play streams directly without requiring dedicated AceStream software on client devices.
